scope: Bounded PIT/data-feasibility audit only. This artifact does not claim exhaustive global data absence.
reason: The P1 literature gate is complete enough to permit a PIT/data-feasibility audit, but the currently verified HENGCE inputs do not establish a historical point-in-time firm-to-firm supplier/customer relationship panel with directed edges, effective validity dates, historical vintages, and no-lookahead timing.

current_library_authority.finding: Industry / Supply Chain / Lead-Lag is PROVISIONALLY_SATURATED for P1; the next permitted stage is PIT/data-feasibility audit, not feature construction or return testing.

historical_capability_audit.finding: TRUE_FIRM_NETWORK_MAPPING_ABSENT within the then-audited existing sources; relationship endpoints, direction, effective dates, historical vintages and PIT state were not verified. This historical artifact is evidence only and is not imported as current authority.

current_bounded_recheck.finding: No new admissible PIT-safe firm relationship panel was identified in the bounded current repo/library recheck.

forbidden_substitutions: Do not backcast a current supplier/customer graph into historical dates.
Do not substitute broad industry membership or peer averages for true firm-to-firm supply-chain edges.
Do not infer relationship edges from contemporaneous price correlation, momentum, turnover, institutional flow, margin financing, or later-known outcomes.
Do not manually construct historical edges using information that was not demonstrably available at the observation date.
separate_family_note: A historically versioned industry/sector hierarchy may be audited as a distinct information family, but it cannot silently substitute for a supply-chain network family and would require its own literature/PIT/preregistration chain.
reopen_conditions: A source provides firm-to-firm relationship edges with explicit direction.
Historical relationship validity or archived vintages allow reconstruction of what was knowable at each observation date.
Publication/revision timing is sufficient to enforce a deterministic no-lookahead rule.
Coverage is measured for the intended Taiwan electronics universe before any forward return is inspected.
note: The previously observed Market State x generic selection interaction does not cure this data deficiency and does not authorize a state-conditioned Industry / Supply Chain / Lead-Lag challenger.
